content: CQRS projection telemetry best practices: (1) Lag = (head_event_position - checkpoint_position) — the number of events the projection is behind the event stream head. (2) Per-projector metrics: current checkpoint, events processed (counter), events failed (counter), processing latency histogram, rebuild progress (%, events_done/total). (3) OTel spans: one span per event processed with event_type, stream_id, projector_name tags. (4) Catch-up vs live-mode signal: emit a :caught_up event/metric when lag drops to 0. (5) Dead-letter queue depth as alert metric. (6) Checkpoint persistence latency.
